title: JobTrack
description: A full-stack job application tracker with organized pipeline, real hiring stages, visualized data to help you optimize your job search strategy, and a sleek, intuitive interface.

title: RecruitLense
description: AI tool for candidates and recruiters that analyzes job descriptions and resumes to provide personalized feedback, optimize keyword usage, and improve matching accuracy for better hiring outcomes.

title: 22SquareBar
description: Full-stack website for a local restaurant, featuring a dynamic menu and admin dashboard for managing items and customer feedback.

title: CashTensor
description: Personal finance tracker with categories, monthly reports, and spending insights. Built using AWS DynamoDB for scalable data storage, GraphQL for efficient data access, and a React frontend for an intuitive user experience.

title: 2D RPG Game
description: A 2D turn-based RPG game built with TypeScript and Express backend. Players go through 5 stages of monster battles, with a final boss fight at the end. The game features a simple yet engaging combat system, character progression, and a variety of monsters to defeat.
